name: list_distributions
description: List available distributions from Alliance Cloud.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100).

name: get_distribution
description: Retrieve a single distribution by ID.

distribution_id.description: The distribution ID returned by list_distributions.

name: ack_distribution
description: Acknowledge (ACK) a distribution, marking it as successfully processed.

distribution_id.description: The ID of the distribution to acknowledge.

name: nak_distribution
description: Negative-acknowledge (NAK) a distribution, rejecting it. Use this when a distribution is malformed, unsupported, or should not be processed.

distribution_id.description: The ID of the distribution to reject.

reason.description: Optional textual reason for the NAK (max 255 chars).

name: download_fin_messages
description: Download FIN (MT) messages for a specific distribution. The Swift API requires distribution_id; calls without it return 400. Use when the user asks for FIN messages tied to a specific distribution.

distribution_id.description: The distribution ID whose FIN messages should be downloaded. Required by the Swift API.

name: download_fin_message
description: Download a single FIN (MT) message by its distribution ID. Use when the user wants the actual message body for one specific distribution.

distribution_id.description: The distribution ID of the FIN message to download.

name: send_fin_message
description: Send a FIN (MT) message to Alliance Cloud. Use for outbound MT103, MT202, and other MT-format messages.

sender_reference.description: Unique back-office reference for reconciliation (max 70 chars). Must be unique per institution (UUMID).

message_type.description: MT message type in format fin.<type>[.<variant>]. Examples: fin.103, fin.103.REMIT, fin.202, fin.202.COV

payload.description: The MT message body (the block content as a string).

name: download_interact_messages
description: Download InterAct (MX) messages for a specific distribution. The Swift API requires distribution_id; calls without it return 400. Use when the user asks for InterAct or MX messages tied to a specific distribution.

distribution_id.description: The distribution ID whose InterAct messages should be downloaded. Required by the Swift API.

name: download_interact_message
description: Download a single InterAct (MX) message by its distribution ID. Use when the user wants the message body for one specific InterAct distribution.

distribution_id.description: The distribution ID of the InterAct message to download.

name: send_interact_message
description: Send an InterAct (MX) message to Alliance Cloud. Use for outbound pacs.008, pain.001, camt.*, and other MX-format messages.

service_code.description: SWIFTNet service code (max 30 chars). Example: swift.cbprplus.02

message_type.description: MX message type in format <area>.<type>.<variant>.<version>. Example: pacs.008.001.08, ifds.001.001.01

requestor.description: Distinguished name (DN) of the sending party.

responder.description: Distinguished name (DN) of the receiving party.

usage_identifier.description: Optional usage identifier for business validation rules.
